title: Cognitive Gateway Skill Definition
description: The strict v2 self-contained contract for a reusable skill.

schema_version.description: The only supported self-contained skill-document schema version.

authoritative_sources.description: Declarative source selectors or patterns used to apply the skill.

rules.description: Declarative rules and instructions belonging to the skill.

verification.description: Declarative verification guidance belonging to the skill.

requires.description: Ordered, unique mandatory SkillId dependencies. Cycles are rejected by the registry.

related_skills.description: Ordered, unique optional or related SkillId references.

required_capability_ids.description: Ordered, unique abstract CapabilityId requirements; these do not grant permission.

knowledge_queries.description: Ordered retrieval hints represented by KnowledgeQuery values.

description.description: Required non-whitespace text; domain validation also rejects disallowed control characters.
